hero.headline: Precision you can hold.
hero.subhead: For over two decades, Master Simex has turned paper into secure documents, everyday essentials and packaging that brands are proud to ship — all made in-house.

manifesto.body: Paper is deceptively simple. Getting it right for the security of a bank form, the crispness of a textbook, the click of a rigid box lid — takes two decades of craft and machinery to match. At Master Simex, every sheet, roll and box is designed, printed, converted and finished under our own roof. That control is why 95% of our clients keep coming back.

whatWeDo.headline: Six specialisms. One roof.
whatWeDo.intro: From secure computer forms to luxury rigid boxes, our portfolio is built to meet the most specialised demands — blending advanced technology with uncompromising quality.

capabilities.headline: Nothing leaves our control.
capabilities.body: Design, pre-press, printing, converting, finishing, binding and packaging — every step happens across our three facilities. World-leading presses run by people who've spent careers perfecting them. That's how we hold defect rates below 1%.

sustainability.headline: Harnessing the sun.
sustainability.body: In 2025 we switched on a solar project that now powers half of our Narsingdi facility. We recycle up to 95% of our waste paper and cut over 1,000 tonnes of carbon a year. Growth and responsibility aren't competing priorities here — they're the same plan.

clients.headline: Trusted where accuracy matters most.
clients.body: For more than twenty years we've served the sectors that can't afford a mistake — government, finance, education, healthcare and the country's leading brands.

closing.headline: Let's make it together.
closing.body: Tell us what you need to print, convert or package. We'll tell you how we'll do it — and by when.

footer.tagline: Redefining Bangladesh's paper, printing and packaging industry since 2002.
